gloss: dead end; end of a street

definitions.gloss: dead end; end of a street or corridor
definitions.explanation: the point where a road, hallway, or path ends and you cannot go further in that direction

examples.japanese: {突|つ}き{当|あ}たりを{右|みぎ}に{曲|ま}がってください。
examples.english: Turn right at the end of the street.

examples.japanese: この{廊下|ろうか}の{突|つ}き{当|あ}たりにトイレがある。
examples.english: The restroom is at the end of this hallway.

examples.japanese: {突|つ}き{当|あ}たりまで{行|い}くと{海|うみ}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: If you go to the end, you can see the ocean.

notes:
FORMATION:
{突|つ}く (to thrust, poke) + {当|あ}たる (to hit) → hitting a wall/end

USAGE:
Commonly used when giving directions. Indicates where a path ends or where one must turn.

ALTERNATE FORM:
{突き当たり|つきあたり} (single word)

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {行|い}き{止|ど}まり (dead end, no through road)
- {袋小路|ふくろこうじ} (cul-de-sac, blind alley)

VERB FORM:
{突|つ}き{当|あ}たる (to reach the end, to hit)
